hero.lead: Every model and workflow behind one key: multi-modal, streaming or async, with usage billing and a reconcilable ledger.

features.title: Hand integration, billing, and ops to the gateway

api.d: One /v1/run endpoint for every model and workflow, provider differences abstracted away.

billing.d: µcredit-precise metering; hold, settle, and refund stay fully auditable.

exec.d: blocking, stream (SSE), async-poll, and async-callback modes.

dify.d: Upload a DSL; io_schema and a compatibility report are extracted automatically.

files.d: Text, image, video, audio. Presigned direct upload to unified object storage.

pay.d: Stripe, Alipay, WeChat, crypto. Top-ups post to the ledger and fulfill automatically.

how.title: From integration to settlement in minutes

s1.d: Create a tenant and key in the console; set the allowlist and rate limits.

s2.d: One interface; pick blocking, stream, or async execution per call.

s3.d: Charged precisely by usage; hold to settle writes to the ledger.

pricing.title: Pay as you go, µcredit precise on every call
pricing.lead: No minimums; top up and go. Enterprises bring their own providers and discounts per channel.

payg.d: Billed by actual usage on every call; the ledger is auditable.

team.d: Multi-tenant, modifier discounts, dedicated channels and reconciliation.

cta.title: Unify your AI calls today
cta.lead: Integrate in minutes and get billing, a ledger, and multi-mode execution.
